name: Dora-Con Cafe 2
source:
A maid café where you can meet dragons—a place overflowing with dragons. Its name: Dra-Maid Café. The shop’s name has officially been set as “Lumière.” And so, another legend of the Progenitor Dragon, Lady Marmalydia Dot Fearburn, is born in this otherworldly land…

“You are truly magnificent, Lady Lydia!”

However, the draconic way of life doesn’t simply end because one goal has been achieved.

To our [s]Love Nest[/s] Maid Café comes… A DISRUPTIVE INTRUSION! Almorat Milmidia, my fellow disciple and one of the Seven Dragon Kings, has arrived.

She states her purpose: she has come to bring back Pasraladia, another of the Seven Dragon Kings who arrived before her.

As if one [s]nuisance[/s] high-maintenance disciple wasn’t enough, now there are two of them at once?! To think they would dare interfere with my sweet, private time with Lady Lydia…!

I immediately captured Pasraladia, who was caught selling bootleg figures of Lady Lydia on the black market. Naturally, all figures were [s]claimed for myself[/s] confiscated and disposed of.

Since they need to recharge their mana to return to Fearburn, I have—reluctantly—put them both to work at the Dra-Maid Café. I thought this would give me more free time with Lady Lydia, but…

As expected of the Seven Dragon Kings who even Lady Lydia struggled with, they are a handful. With one trouble after another, there isn’t a single moment to relax.

Almorat tries to dye the entire shop in nothing but “cuteness”… While Pasra tries every trick in the book to make a profit off of Lady Lydia…

Good grief! It seems a peaceful, relaxing life at the maid café is still a long way off.
translation:
能与龙相遇的女仆咖啡厅——充满龙的地方。它的名字是：德拉女仆咖啡馆。店名正式定为“Lumière”。于是，另一个祖龙传说，玛玛莉迪亚夫人·多特·菲尔伯恩，在这片异界之地诞生了……

“你真是太伟大了，莉迪亚大人！”

然而，龙类的生活方式并不会因为一个目标的实现而简单地结束。

我们的[s]爱巢[/s]女仆咖啡厅来了……破坏性的入侵！我的同门、七龙王之一的阿尔莫拉特·米尔米蒂亚已经抵达。

她说出了自己的目的：她来这里是为了带回在她之前到达的七龙王中的另一位帕斯拉拉迪亚。

好像一个[s]讨厌[/s]高维护弟子还不够，现在竟然是两个？！没想到他们竟然敢干涉我和莉迪亚女士甜蜜的私人时光……！

我立即抓获了帕斯拉拉迪亚，她因在黑市上出售莉迪亚女士的盗版手办而被捕。当然，所有的数字都被[s]本人认领[/s]没收并处理掉。

由于他们需要补充法力才能返回菲尔本，我很不情愿地让他们俩去德拉女仆咖啡馆工作。我以为这会让我有更多的空闲时间和莉迪亚女士在一起，但是……

连莉蒂亚大人都与之较量的七龙王，果然是屈指可数。烦恼接二连三，没有一刻可以放松。

阿尔莫拉特试图将整个商店染成“可爱”……而帕斯拉则想方设法从莉迪亚女士身上获利……

好悲伤！看来距离女仆咖啡厅平静悠闲的生活还很遥远。
